$comment_dependencies: This project has a HARD, compile-time dependency on the Nebula Logger unmanaged/unlocked package (https://github.com/jongpie/NebulaLogger) - see DVC_LoggerService.cls. It is intentionally NOT declared under packageDirectories[].dependencies here, since we don't yet have the real installed package version Id (04t...) for this org, and a placeholder/invalid Id would break `sf org create scratch` for every developer. Once the real Nebula Logger package version Id is known, add: packageDirectories[0].dependencies = [{ "package": "Nebula Logger", "versionNumber": "<version>" }] and packageAliases = { "Nebula Logger": "<real 04t... Id>" }. See docs/DMS-4909-DEVELOPMENT.md for manual installation instructions in the meantime.
